description: This PHP class 'ResultPaginator' in the AWS SDK provides an iterator for paginating results of AWS API calls, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations, with methods for searching within paginated results.

classes.name: ResultPaginator
classes.description: An iterator class to handle the pagination of AWS SDK API responses, capable of asynchronous operation, searching within results, and managing pagination tokens.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the paginator with AWS client, operation name, arguments, and configuration, and sets up metrics middleware.

methods.name: each
methods.description: Executes the paginator asynchronously, invoking a callback for each page of results, supporting promise merging.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns an iterator that applies a JMESPath search expression to each page of results.

methods.name: current
methods.description: Returns the current result object in the iteration.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Returns the current position key in the iteration.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next result in the iteration.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Checks if the current position is valid, loading more results if necessary.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the pagination to initial state.

methods.name: createNextCommand
methods.description: Creates the next command for the AWS client with updated pagination token.

methods.name: determineNextToken
methods.description: Determines the next pagination token based on the current result and configuration.
